d: The US-Iran war takes a tense turn as Donald Trump declares the conflict effectively over while keeping American forces on high alert. Iran rejects Washington's claims and demands US surrender to seven conditions. Fresh strikes target strategic radar and navigation facilities near the Strait of Hormuz, while US forces hit Iranian military sites. Tehran pushes a new two-day peace proposal to restore security in the vital shipping corridor. Oil prices slide on hopes of de-escalation, but rising military tensions leave the threat of a renewed US-Iran conflict far from over. Josh Barnes tells…
